content:
**Glowing Fungus Soup** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

Soup made from Glowing Fungus.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (1) Glowing Fungus (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Glowing Fungus | | Glowing Fungus Soup (1) | 

- Craftable at any Cooking Station after having picked up Glowing Fungus for the first time.
- Can be found in the Communist Collectron Station, when it is run in "Proletariat" mode.
